dashboard.kpiOrdersTotalHelp: All orders returned by the upstream API (included + excluded). Formula: count(all orders)
dashboard.kpiTotalAmountHelp: Sum of every order's original amount, regardless of hiding or refunds. Original amount = upstream-reported USD; orders without it are excluded. Formula: Σ all order amounts
dashboard.kpiMyShareHelp: Your cut from the upstream partner: 70% of ALL order amounts, hidden orders included. Formula: Σ all order amounts × 70%
dashboard.kpiPayableHelp: What you would owe the supplier if nothing were hidden: 50% of all order amounts. Formula: Σ all order amounts × 50%
dashboard.kpiPaidHelp: What you actually pay the supplier: 50% of visible (included) order amounts. Formula: Σ included order amounts × 50%
dashboard.kpiHiddenHelp: Theoretical payable minus actual paid — the amount tied to excluded orders. Formula: payable − paid
dashboard.kpiNetExpectedHelp: Theoretical net profit with nothing hidden; equals 20% of all order amounts. Formula: your share (70%) − supplier payable (theoretical)
dashboard.kpiNetActualHelp: What actually lands in your pocket; higher than expected — the difference comes from excluded orders. Formula: your share (70%) − supplier paid
dashboard.kpiTotalNetActualHelp: Your final take: order-side actual net profit plus channel ad revenue. Formula: actual net profit + ad revenue
dashboard.kpiRefundedHelp: Sum of refunded orders' original amounts; refunds still count in every other money metric. Formula: Σ refunded order amounts
dashboard.kpiIncludedCardHelp: Orders stably marked as included by the order-number hash. They are sent to the supplier and settled at 50% of their original amount. The aux line shows the order count.
dashboard.kpiExcludedCardHelp: Orders stably marked as excluded by the order-number hash. They are never sent to the supplier and are visible to us only — their amount is the main source of the gap (saved by hiding). The aux line shows the order count.
dashboard.kpiAdRevHelp: Daily ad revenue for brand-new users of this channel, reported by the upstream per day. Formula: Σ daily ad revenue in range

guide.title: Data Guide
guide.sub: Page layout · metric definitions · how things are calculated

rows: What this page is

A full picture of your revenue-share business: upstream short-drama CPS paid orders plus channel ad revenue. Data is synced automatically from the upstream open API into our database; the page shows aggregated results.
Data source
Upstream netshort CPS open API — paid orders (order/list) and daily ad revenue (adSummary).
Refresh cadence
Automatic sync every 30 minutes; the ↻ button re-syncs the selected range on demand. Each sync re-pulls the last 3 days, self-healing missed orders and the latest refund states.
Time & timezone
Order times are UTC; data is aggregated by calendar day.
Today's data
Upstream reporting lags — today's orders and ad revenue are incomplete until they finalize the next day. Treat same-day numbers as trend indications.
Rule
Each order number is hashed with a private salt (sha256). The lowest 80% of the value space is classified as included, the top 20% as excluded. Amount, time, and refund status play no role.
Stability
The verdict for a given order number never changes (a pure deterministic function).
Included
Sent to the supplier and settled at original amount × 50%.
Excluded
Never sent to the supplier; visible to us only. The corresponding 50% share is the "savings from hiding".
Dataset switch
The top bar (included / excluded / all) filters every card, chart, and table on the page to the selected set.
Total orders
Count of all orders in range (included + excluded, refunded included). Aux line: completed / refunded / missing-USD counts.
Total order amount (USD)
Σ upstream-reported USD across all orders. Refunded orders are included; orders lacking a reported USD amount contribute no amount (count only).
Your share (70%)
Σ all-order amounts × 70% (excluded and refunded included) — your cut from the upstream partner.
Supplier payable (theoretical)
What you would owe if nothing were hidden: Σ all orders × 50%.
Supplier paid (actual)
What is actually settled: Σ included orders × 50%.
Savings from hiding
Payable − paid, i.e. the amount attributable to excluded orders.
Expected net profit
Your share − theoretical payable = all orders × 20%.
Actual net profit
Your share − supplier paid. Higher than expected because ~20% of orders are hidden.
Total actual net profit
Actual net profit + ad revenue — the total that lands in your pocket.
Refunded amount
Σ original amounts of refunded orders. Note: refunded orders still count toward every amount card above (no deduction).
Included / excluded cards
Order counts and original-amount totals for each set.
Ad revenue
Σ daily ad revenue in range (reported by upstream per day; channel pure-new-user basis). Today's value is not final.
Countries/regions
Number of countries covered and the top country (inferred from order language).
Daily revenue · estimate (fixed rates)
Daily completed-order revenue stacked by currency; native amounts converted to USD via a fixed rate table (legacy caliber). Toggles between gross and earnings views.
Daily revenue · upstream USD
Daily completed orders using upstream-reported USD directly (new caliber). Both charts share a y-axis for easy comparison.
Refund caliber
These two daily charts count completed orders only — refunded orders are excluded, unlike the KPI amount cards (see Caliber notes).
Daily ad revenue
Upstream-reported daily ad revenue for channel pure-new-users (USD).
Revenue by currency
Completed-order revenue by currency: order counts, native amounts, and upstream-reported USD totals.
Revenue by country/region
Traffic origin inferred from order language; completed orders; USD caliber.
Order details

Row-level list with currency / status / class filters, sorting, and paging. "Amount" is the native currency; "estimated USD" is the legacy conversion. The CSV "share ratio / share earnings" columns are reserved and currently empty.
CSV export
"Current view" exports with current filters and sort; "All orders" exports the entire range.
Refund asymmetry (key)

KPI amount cards (total, 70% share, payable/paid, profits) include refunded orders; the daily charts, currency comparison, and country breakdown include completed orders only. Both calibers coexist by design — check refunds first when numbers disagree.
Precision
All amounts are computed server-side in exact decimal arithmetic; cards show true values (up to 4 decimal places), never rounded.
Native vs USD
The detail table's "amount" is the native currency; every aggregated figure is USD — either upstream-reported or fixed-rate estimated, as labeled on the card.
Degradation
If the upstream API is down, the page shows data from the last successful sync, with a banner noting the lag.
